notes: No 1983 model-year production Corvette (43 pilot cars with 1983 VINs; one survives at the National Corvette Museum). C4 production began January 1983 as 1984 models.

Independence: all GM material (Heritage kits, spec sheets, order guides, press releases, chevrolet.com, and GM documents re-hosted by Corvette Action Center or reprinted by conceptcarz) is ONE manufacturer source. Corvette Action Center counts separately only for its own C4 spec tables (1984-1993) and its LT5 page. All Wikipedia articles count as one source. EPA counts for displacement/cylinders/induction only and cannot separate same-size engines (L98 vs LT5, LT1 vs LT4 in 1996, LS1 vs LS6). KBB (kbb.com year pages, 1992+) is the publication source.
All ratings SAE net. hp_alt = second factory rating for the same engine that year (exhaust/axle/head variants). NHRA guide has Corvette rows only for 1984, 1986-87, 1989-92, 1995-96, 2000-08.
Blocked/unusable: GM Authority (403), Edmunds/cars.com (403), media.chevrolet.com (redirect); news.gm.com pages for E-Ray launch and 2025 ZR1 returned 404.
